headline: Review a Chase Street one-way street order, a 37 Enon Street apartment project, and traffic safety concerns at two intersections.
summary: The Commission will consider a one-way street change on part of Chase Street, a site plan and special permit for a 179-unit apartment project at 37 Enon Street, and traffic and pedestrian safety concerns at two intersections. The meeting also includes a construction update and approval of minutes.
items: Recommendation to City Council on Order #234-2026 to amend Chapter 270, Section 36, making part of Chase Street (northerly from West Dane Street to Roundy Street) a one-way street, submitted by Keith Sonia, Councilor-at-Large

Recommendation to the Planning Board on Site Plan Review (SPR 26-42) and Special Permit (SP-26-5) for new construction at 37 Enon Street with 179 residential apartments, about 2,600 sf of retail space, and 281 parking spaces where 367 are required, including a Special Permit for 1.5 parking spaces per unit, submitted by Beverly Tre LLC c/o Alexander & Femino
Constituent Issue Review of traffic and pedestrian safety concerns at the intersection of Pickett Street and Baker Ave, submitted by Scott Houseman, Ward 4 City Councilor
Constituent Issue Review of traffic and pedestrian safety concerns at the intersection of Peabody Avenue, Larcom Avenue, and Sargent Avenue, submitted by Scott Houseman, Ward 4 City Councilor
Construction or Project Update on 119 Rantoul Street, Wendell Holmes LLC (owner), currently under construction, no update
location: 1st Floor Conference Room, Temporary Beverly City Hall, 195 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA
